entries.title: CVE-2026-112459 · IOMobileFrameBuffer
entries.summary: Apple fixed an IOMobileFrameBuffer race condition in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2. PhantomBugz is the researcher credited anonymously in the advisory alongside Lily Cohl (@GenericCoding).
